note: Verified 2026-09-26. Most entries come from the Root to Rise Resource Navigator dataset (HSDS-style, see docs/DATA-FORMAT.md); a few were verified by the web team. Hours change often — call to confirm.

resources.name: Falmouth Service Center
resources.service: Food pantry (client-choice) and fuel-assistance application help
resources.description: Client-choice food distribution serving all of Cape Cod; senior (60+) shopping by appointment; in-person help applying for SSCAC fuel assistance (HEAP). Office visits by appointment Mon–Fri.
resources.hours: Food: Tue 10am–12pm, Wed 3:30–5:30pm, Thu 10am–12pm, Fri 10am–12pm; Seniors 60+: Thu 1–2pm by appointment
resources.eligibility: Open to Cape Cod residents; call for details

resources.name: St. Barnabas's Episcopal Church – A Place at the Table
resources.service: A Place at the Table – free hot lunch
resources.description: Free hot lunches; open to all, no registration.

resources.name: St. Vincent de Paul Society – St. Joseph Guardian of the Holy Family Parish
resources.service: St. Vincent de Paul Food Pantry (at St. Patrick Church)
resources.description: Perishable and non-perishable food; limit 2 visits/month.

resources.name: Christ the King Parish – St. Vincent de Paul
resources.service: Christ the King Food Pantry
resources.description: Client-choice pantry; delivery available to some areas.

resources.name: Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe
resources.service: MWT Food Pantry
resources.description: Tribal food pantry; orders placed by phone on arrival.
resources.eligibility: Call to confirm who is eligible

resources.name: The Salvation Army – Hyannis Corps
resources.service: Food pantry and soup kitchen
resources.description: Free breakfast and lunch weekdays; pantry by appointment.
resources.hours: Meals Mon–Fri: breakfast 8:30–9:30am, lunch 11:30am–12:30pm; pantry by appointment Mon–Thu 10–11:15am (call to confirm)

resources.name: Cape Cod Council of Churches
resources.service: Faith Family Kitchen – free hot evening meals
resources.description: Hot meals for all; dine-in or carry-out; distributed at back door off Bacon Street.

resources.name: St. Vincent de Paul – St. Francis Xavier Church
resources.service: St. Vincent de Paul Food Pantry (Hyannis)
resources.description: Perishables and non-perishables.

resources.name: First Baptist Church of Hyannis
resources.service: First Baptist Church Pantry
resources.description: Fresh produce, perishables and non-perishables.

resources.name: Cape Cod Family Resource Center (a program of Advocates)
resources.service: Family resource center – basic needs pantry, referrals
resources.description: Shelf-stable food, hygiene and cleaning products; family support and referrals; walk-ins welcome.

resources.name: Family Table Collaborative
resources.service: Free drive-through meal distribution
resources.description: Free meals, drive-through at Hyannis Youth & Community Center; text to sign up.

resources.name: Elder Services of Cape Cod and the Islands
resources.service: Meals on Wheels & senior dining; SHINE/elder supports
resources.description: Home-delivered meals for homebound adults 60+ and senior dining.

resources.name: Barnstable County – Cape Cod Cooperative Extension
resources.service: Cape Cod Food Access Directory (all pantries & meal sites)
resources.description: Official county list of food pantries, meal programs and community fridges across Cape Cod & Islands.

resources.name: Gándara Center
resources.service: PIER Recovery Center of Cape Cod (peer recovery support center)
resources.description: Free, peer-led recovery support: recovery coaching, relapse-prevention groups, social events, computers for job search, advocacy. Membership free; all pathways.
resources.hours: Call or check Facebook for schedule
resources.eligibility: Anyone in or seeking recovery, and families

resources.name: Gándara Center
resources.service: Falmouth Peer Recovery Center
resources.description: State-funded peer recovery support center: peer support, recovery coaching, groups, social activities. Closest recovery center to Falmouth/Mashpee.

resources.name: South East Recovery Learning Community (Vinfen)
resources.service: Hyannis Recovery Connection Center
resources.description: Free peer support (mental health, substance use, trauma recovery); no referral or insurance needed. Parent Connection group (Wed), young-adult 'Thursday Night In' (5:30–7pm).

resources.name: Cape Cod Intergroup of Alcoholics Anonymous
resources.service: AA 24-hour hotline & meeting finder
resources.description: 24/7 hotline and Cape & Islands AA meeting list.

resources.name: New England Region of Narcotics Anonymous (NERNA)
resources.service: NA meeting finder (Cape Cod & Massachusetts)
resources.description: Regional NA meeting listings.

resources.name: Gosnold Behavioral Health
resources.service: Detox (inpatient withdrawal management), treatment & admissions line
resources.description: Inpatient medical detox, clinical stabilization, residential, outpatient, MAT and family programs. Main campus in Falmouth.

resources.name: Massachusetts Substance Use Helpline
resources.service: Free, confidential treatment & recovery referral line
resources.description: Finds licensed/approved substance use treatment and recovery services statewide; interpreters available.

resources.name: AIDS Support Group of Cape Cod (ASGCC)
resources.service: Harm reduction: syringe services, free Narcan, HIV/HCV testing (incl. Falmouth mobile van)
resources.description: Syringe services, free Narcan (naloxone), STI/HIV/HCV screening, safer-use supplies; mobile outreach van serves Falmouth & Upper Cape (call for hours).
resources.hours: Call for hours (mobile van: call for schedule)

resources.name: Health Imperatives
resources.service: Harm reduction & substance use disorder medication/support (Hyannis)
resources.description: Harm reduction services, SUD medication & support, sexual/reproductive health.

resources.name: Duffy Health Center
resources.service: Health care for people experiencing homelessness; MAT and behavioral health
resources.description: Primary care, behavioral health, medication for addiction treatment, case management; Portuguese spoken.

resources.name: Community Health Center of Cape Cod
resources.service: Primary care, behavioral health & MAT (Mashpee & Falmouth sites)
resources.description: Community health center with sites in Mashpee (107 Commercial St), Falmouth (210 Jones Rd), Bourne, Centerville, Sandwich.

resources.name: Learn to Cope
resources.service: Family support meetings (loved ones of people with SUD); naloxone training
resources.description: Peer support network for families; free naloxone training at meetings.

resources.name: Massachusetts Behavioral Health Help Line (MBHP for the Commonwealth)
resources.service: 24/7 mental health & substance use help line (call or text)
resources.description: Free, confidential, no insurance needed; 200+ languages; connects to clinical help and mobile crisis.

resources.name: Bay Cove Behavioral Health & Wellness Center (Community Behavioral Health Center)
resources.service: 24/7 youth & adult mobile crisis; urgent behavioral health (open access)
resources.description: Mobile crisis clinician usually arrives within an hour; open-access walk-in evaluations; can arrange detox/hospital admission.
resources.fees: Insurance/MassHealth; no one turned away for crisis

resources.name: Housing Assistance Corporation (Housing Assistance)
resources.service: Housing counseling, family shelters, housing search & energy-efficiency programs
resources.description: HUD-approved housing counseling for Cape & Islands; operates family shelters with the state (apply via EOHLC); housing search help; energy-efficiency/heating system programs (HEAP itself is run by SSCAC).

resources.name: MA Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities (EOHLC)
resources.service: Emergency Assistance (EA) family shelter application
resources.description: Families with children or pregnant people apply for state family shelter centrally; in-person help at DTA Hyannis on Tuesdays 9am–3pm.
resources.eligibility: Families with children/pregnant; income & other rules

resources.name: Catholic Charities (Diocese of Fall River) – St. Joseph's House
resources.service: St. Joseph's House – overnight shelter for individuals + day program
resources.description: The only overnight shelter for individual adults on Cape Cod (up to 50 guests); day program with case management and a weekly recovery group. Not first-come: call for bed availability/intake. Proposed move to 460 West Main St is in litigation — still at Winter St as of 2026-09-26.

resources.name: Champ Homes, Inc.
resources.service: Transitional housing for adults who are homeless or near homeless
resources.description: Faith-based transitional housing with life skills, mentoring and vocational support.

resources.name: Mass 211
resources.service: Mass 211 – 24/7 information & referral (incl. RAFT, shelter, housing & fuel questions)
resources.description: Dial 211, 24/7, interpreters available; basic RAFT program questions and referrals statewide.

resources.name: MA Department of Transitional Assistance (DTA)
resources.service: DTA Hyannis office – SNAP, TAFDC, EAEDC applications & EBT cards
resources.description: Apply, submit documents, get an EBT card; kiosks, phones and interpreters available. Apply online at DTAConnect.com.

resources.name: Community Action Committee of Cape Cod & Islands (CACCI)
resources.service: SNAP application assistance, health insurance enrollment help, free tax prep, emergency assistance
resources.description: Help applying for SNAP and MassHealth/Health Connector, free income tax preparation, emergency and seasonal assistance.

resources.name: Project Bread
resources.service: FoodSource Hotline – SNAP help & food resources
resources.description: Statewide food help hotline in 180 languages; SNAP screening and application help.

resources.name: MassHealth
resources.service: MassHealth / Health Connector application & customer service
resources.description: Apply online at mahealthconnector.org or by phone.

resources.name: Town of Mashpee – Human Services
resources.service: Mashpee Human Services – referrals and fuel-assistance intake (under 60)
resources.description: Town human services; outreach site for fuel assistance applications for households under 60 (by appointment). Seniors 60+: Mashpee Senior Center 508-539-1440.

resources.name: South Shore Community Action Council (SSCAC)
resources.service: Home Energy Assistance Program (HEAP / fuel assistance) for Cape Cod & Islands
resources.description: Administers MA fuel assistance for the South Shore, Cape Cod & Islands; online pre-application; phone help; Mashpee outreach site at 133 Falmouth Rd (Shellback Place) Bldg 1 Suite E (Mon/Wed/Fri 9–3:30 during 2025–26 season).
resources.hours: Season Nov 1 – Apr 30; applications from Oct 1; outreach-site hours call to confirm

resources.name: MA Department of Telecommunications and Cable (DTC)
resources.service: Lifeline phone/internet discount – MA consumer help
resources.description: Explains MA Lifeline eligibility (SNAP, MassHealth, SSI, public housing, VA pension, or income ≤135% FPG). Apply through USAC (lifelinesupport.org).

resources.name: Cape Cod Regional Transit Authority (CCRTA)
resources.service: Fixed-route buses, DART on-demand rides, Boston Hospital transportation
resources.description: Cape-wide bus routes (incl. Falmouth/Mashpee/Hyannis), DART curb-to-curb on-demand service, and rides to Boston hospitals. Hyannis Transportation Center has construction as of Sept 2026.
resources.fees: Fares apply; reduced fares available — call

resources.name: Health Imperatives – Cape Cod WIC
resources.service: WIC nutrition program (Hyannis & Mashpee)
resources.description: WIC for pregnant/postpartum people, infants and children under 5. Mashpee office at Deer Crossing, 681 Falmouth Rd, Bldg B21 (508-540-9742; Tue 11–7, Wed 8:30–4:30). Mobile sites in Eastham & Harwich.
other_locations: 681 Falmouth Road, Building B21 (upper level), Mashpee, MA
resources.hours: Hyannis: Mon 8:30–4:30, Tue 11–7, Wed–Thu 8:30–4:30, Fri 8:30–2, one Sat/month 9–1

resources.name: Nashua Soup Kitchen & Shelter
resources.service: Community meals, food pantry, emergency shelter & case management
resources.description: Breakfast and dinner; food boxes and fresh produce; emergency shelter for individuals and families; help with IDs and employment costs. No ID required for meals.
resources.hours: Breakfast Mon–Fri 7:30–8:30am; dinner Mon–Fri 4–6pm; Sat–Sun 12–2pm. Food boxes Mon, Wed–Fri 11am–2:45pm; Tue 5:30–7pm (call to confirm)
resources.eligibility: Anyone in need in Greater Nashua

resources.name: Southern New Hampshire Rescue Mission
resources.service: Emergency shelter (men: Mercy House; women: Hope Center), daily community meals, food pantry
resources.description: Men's shelter at 40 Chestnut St; women's shelter (Hope Center) at 36 Tolles St (603-521-7127); daily community meals; food pantry & clothing every other Tuesday by appointment. Faith-based longer-term programs.
resources.hours: Breakfast Mon–Fri 7am, Sat–Sun 8am; lunch Mon, Wed–Fri 12pm; dinner Sat–Sun 5pm (call to confirm)

resources.name: Corpus Christi Food Pantry & Assistance
resources.service: Food pantry; help with rent, evictions, utility shut-offs, bus passes/gas vouchers
resources.description: Pantry by appointment; assistance program helps with rent, evictions, utilities, and transportation (603-598-1641).
resources.hours: Mon & Wed mornings, Tue & Thu afternoons – by appointment

resources.name: Tolles Street Mission
resources.service: Food pantry
resources.description: Food pantry four days a week.
resources.hours: Mon & Thu 12–2pm; Tue & Wed 10:30am–12:30pm (call to confirm)

resources.name: The Salvation Army – Nashua
resources.service: Monthly food pantry; back-rent & utility assistance (by appointment)
resources.description: Pantry available monthly (bring proof of residence); financial help with back rent and utilities by appointment as funds allow.

resources.name: Grace Lutheran Church
resources.service: Evening food pantry
resources.description: Monthly evening pantry.

resources.name: United Way of Greater Nashua
resources.service: Pop-up food pantries, homebound pantry delivery, free VITA tax prep
resources.description: Daily pop-up pantries with Regenerative Roots Association, volunteer delivery for homebound pantry clients, free tax preparation (VITA), Rosie's Pantry hygiene items.

resources.name: YMCA of Greater Nashua
resources.service: Community food pantry; warming/cooling station; Y Cares financial aid
resources.description: Food pantry at each YMCA location, open to the community; serves as Nashua's warming & cooling station.

resources.name: Community Action Partnership of Hillsborough & Rockingham Counties (CAPHR; Southern New Hampshire Services, Inc.)
resources.service: Fuel & Electric Assistance, WIC, senior commodity foods (CSFP), weatherization – Nashua office
resources.description: NH Fuel Assistance (grants $188–$2,500; deadline Apr 30, 2027), Electric Assistance, WIC, Commodity Supplemental Food for 60+, summer meals, weatherization.

resources.name: New Hampshire Food Bank
resources.service: SNAP application assistance line
resources.description: Help completing a SNAP application on NH EASY by phone.

resources.name: Revive Recovery Resource Center
resources.service: Peer recovery support center (recovery coaching, telephone recovery support, harm reduction)
resources.description: All pathways (12-Step, SMART, Recovery Dharma, etc.); peer recovery support, telephone recovery support, family groups, yoga/meditation, harm reduction program, CRSW training.

resources.name: The Doorway of Greater Nashua (Southern New Hampshire Health)
resources.service: Substance use screening, crisis stabilization, referral to treatment, free Narcan
resources.description: Hub for SUD help: phone & in-person screening, evaluation, care planning, referral, recovery monitoring, naloxone distribution, transportation help, support for loved ones.
resources.hours: In person Mon–Fri 8am–5pm; 24/7 by phone via 211

resources.name: Harbor Care
resources.service: Health & Wellness Center (primary care, SUD treatment, psychiatry), recovery housing, homeless services
resources.description: Sliding-fee health center (English/Spanish/Portuguese) incl. substance use treatment; Cynthia Day Family Center for women (615 Amherst St); MAT-friendly men's recovery residences; Safe Haven & veterans programs.
resources.eligibility: All ages; no one turned away for inability to pay

resources.name: Greater Nashua Mental Health
resources.service: Mental health & substance use services; walk-in options
resources.description: Behavioral health for all ages incl. SUD services (12+), crisis stabilization, homeless outreach; no one turned away for lack of insurance.
resources.hours: Call / see walk-in options on website

resources.name: Lamprey Health Care – Nashua Center
resources.service: Primary care incl. medications for addiction treatment
resources.description: Primary care regardless of insurance; MAT, behavioral health, pharmacy assistance; also at Nashua Soup Kitchen Tue–Fri 7:30–9:30am.

resources.name: Addiction Recovery Coalition of New Hampshire (ARCNH)
resources.service: Community recovery center (Milford, Greater Nashua area)
resources.description: Free peer-led recovery coaching, family and veteran programming, AA/SMART/All Recovery meetings; all pathways.

resources.name: H.E.A.R.T.S. Peer Support Center of Greater Nashua
resources.service: Mental health peer support center, peer crisis respite & evening warm line
resources.description: Adult peer wellness center; 2-bed peer crisis respite (1–7 days); Peer Support Warm Line 1-888-306-4334, 7 days 5–10pm.
resources.eligibility: Adults 18+ who have used/may need public mental health services

resources.name: Alcoholics Anonymous – New Hampshire (Area 43)
resources.service: AA 24-hour helpline & meeting finder
resources.description: Answering service connects callers with sober AA members; statewide meeting list incl. Nashua (District 13).

resources.name: Granite State Area of Narcotics Anonymous
resources.service: NA 24-hour helpline & meeting list
resources.description: Leave a message (option 3) for a callback; callbacks protect anonymity.

resources.name: NH Rapid Response Access Point (Protocall for NH DHHS)
resources.service: 24/7 mental health & substance use crisis line; mobile crisis dispatch
resources.description: Call for NH-based crisis support; can dispatch mobile crisis teams and arrange same-day help. Text/chat was temporarily unavailable on 2026-09-26 — call instead.

resources.name: Bridges: Domestic & Sexual Violence Support
resources.service: 24-hour domestic & sexual violence support line, emergency shelter, advocacy
resources.description: Crisis intervention, emergency shelter, court advocacy, support groups for anyone of any gender.

resources.name: Greater Nashua Continuum of Care
resources.service: Coordinated Entry – homeless intake, assessment & referral
resources.description: Anyone experiencing homelessness in Greater Nashua calls here for assessment and referral; after hours or outside region call 211.

resources.name: 211 New Hampshire (Granite United Way)
resources.service: 24/7 information & referral; statewide homeless coordinated entry after hours; Doorway access
resources.description: Dial 211 for housing, shelter, food, utilities and Doorway (SUD) connections.

resources.name: Front Door Agency, Inc.
resources.service: Housing stability assistance (back rent, utility arrears, deposits) & transformational housing
resources.description: One-time/short-term help with housing costs; transitional housing for single mothers & children; youth (18–24) homelessness program.

resources.name: Family Promise of Southern New Hampshire
resources.service: Family shelter/transitional housing, eviction prevention & shelter diversion
resources.description: Serves families of all compositions; eviction-prevention financial help (appointment required).

resources.name: City of Nashua – Division of Public Health & Community Services, Welfare Department
resources.service: General Assistance (rent, food, utilities, medications)
resources.description: Voucher-based interim assistance for Nashua residents in financial hardship; confidential interview; apply in person with photo ID and Social Security card.

resources.name: Catholic Charities NH – Nashua
resources.service: Help with electric/gas disconnect notices; financial coaching (English/Spanish)
resources.description: Financial assistance with utility disconnect notices; financial literacy and advocacy.

resources.name: Nashua Housing & Redevelopment Authority
resources.service: Public & affordable housing applications
resources.description: Affordable housing for low-income elderly, disabled and families.

resources.name: NH Department of Health and Human Services
resources.service: DHHS Southern District Office – SNAP, Medicaid, cash assistance, child care applications
resources.description: Apply online at NH EASY (nheasy.nh.gov) or in person; DHHS Customer Service 1-844-ASK-DHHS.

resources.name: 603 Legal Aid / NH Legal Assistance (central intake)
resources.service: Free civil legal help (housing, public benefits, domestic violence)
resources.description: Central intake for civil legal aid for low-income people and older adults; apply online 24/7.
resources.hours: Phone intake limited hours — see website

resources.name: Social Security Administration – Nashua
resources.service: SSI / SSDI / Social Security applications, replacement cards
resources.description: Applications for SSI, disability, retirement; Social Security cards.

resources.name: Aging & Disability Resource Center (ServiceLink) – Nashua
resources.service: Information & referral, options counseling, Medicare (SHIP) counseling
resources.description: No-wrong-door help for older adults and people with disabilities, caregivers; SHIP Medicare counseling.

resources.name: NH Department of Energy – Lifeline Telephone Assistance
resources.service: Lifeline phone/internet discount – NH info
resources.description: Explains NH Lifeline ($9.25/mo discount; SNAP/Medicaid/SSI/FPHA/VA pension or income ≤135% FPG) and lists participating wireline companies. Apply through USAC.

resources.name: Nashua Transit System (City of Nashua)
resources.service: City bus routes & ADA paratransit; free travel training
resources.description: Weekday and Saturday bus service across Nashua (no Sunday service); all buses ADA accessible; free travel training.

resources.name: Gate City Bike Coop
resources.service: No-cost bikes via agency voucher; bike repair instruction
resources.description: Provides bicycles through vouchers from local agencies; open to the public Mondays 3–7pm.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.service: 988 – call, text or chat 24/7
resources.description: Free, confidential support for suicidal, mental health or substance use crisis; Spanish text/chat available. Veterans press 1.

resources.name: Universal Service Administrative Company (USAC) – Lifeline
resources.service: Apply for Lifeline (National Verifier)
resources.description: Up to $9.25/month off phone or internet ($34.25 on Tribal lands); one per household; recertify yearly.

resources.name: MassHire Cape and Islands Career Center
resources.description: Free job search help, training, and workshops.

resources.name: South Coastal Counties Legal Services
resources.description: Free civil legal help (housing, benefits, family, and more) for people with low income on Cape Cod and the South Coast. Intake line Mon–Thu 9am–2pm.

resources.name: MASH Certified Sober Homes directory
resources.description: Massachusetts Alliance for Sober Housing list of certified sober homes that meet national standards. Contact homes directly for openings.

resources.name: NH Works — Nashua
resources.description: Job search help, training, and unemployment services.

resources.name: NH Coordinated Entry (homeless services)
resources.description: If you are homeless or about to be, call to find available shelter beds and housing programs across New Hampshire.

resources.name: Root to Rise Recovery Cafe
resources.description: Recovery cafe and community from Inspiration Is Everywhere. Contact us for gatherings, peer support, and help finding resources.
